result:
The shadow store fix shipped as v32.75, but I did not measure the test-run speed.

**What changed:** `shadowE` now puts the sprite scale in the store key (`ss+':'+sizes`) and no longer empties the store when the scale changes. The 300-entry cap stays. Nothing else changed.

**Check:** it draws three frames at scale 1 and scale 2. It requires:
- no new shadow canvases after frame 1;
- one store entry per scale;
- the same drawn size at both scales.

It was written to fail on the old build, but I did not run it against the old build. The gate also passed, including the seed 4242 fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

**Not done:** the speed proof (`__regressBg(0,120)` under 20 minutes, page under 600 MB). None of the commands I'm allowed to run starts it. Someone should rerun the full test run on v32.75 and record the time. This is written up in `tools/handoff/console/notes/00-perf-shadow-store.md`.

**What to watch in the next playtest:** raids with many bodies and boxes on screen should feel smoother, with fewer frame hitches and less memory growth.

TASK PARTIAL: the speed proof (`__regressBg(0,120)` time and page memory on v32.75) still needs to be run.
